slack.guideStep1: Create a Slack App at api.slack.com/apps
slack.guideStep2: In OAuth & Permissions, add the chat:write scope
slack.guideStep3: Install the app in your workspace and copy the Bot Token
slack.guideStep4: In Event Subscriptions, enable and paste the Webhook URL from step 2
slack.guideStep5: Subscribe to the message.channels or message.im event
slack.guideStep6: Copy the Signing Secret from Basic Information

list_directory.hint: Lists files and directories with sizes. Ideal for exploring project structure.
